messages:
jin: Heads up — QA caught a regression in the quantized kernel build (engine v3.2.1-q). Binary size up ~25% vs v3.2.0, and a few T4 canaries OOMed during long-seq runs. Attaching heap traces and the failing CI job link.
marie: ack. which canaries/regions saw OOM? link?
sam: eu-west-1 night-slice and one us-central small-slice. CPU not spiking. looks like memory footprint growth (likely matmul alignment / padding).
alex: can we pin traffic and halt the rollout ASAP? propose: pin engine:v3.2.1-q to prevent further exposure. also reduce canary to 0% until we validate.
deploybot: Usage: `/deploy pin <target> --scope=<scope> --ttl=<minutes> --note="<reason>"`
jin: tagging @eng-sre — please do emergency pin. also note: packaging job reported a checksum mismatch for one artifact (s3://redwood-artifacts/engine/v3.2.1-q/build-1234.tar.gz). suspect packaging pipeline hiccup.
marie: if we pin, set TTL=120 and note `size-spike-oom-canary`. sam: create a quick telemetry alert: OOM count by region. threshold suggestion: >=2 OOMs within 5m -> rollback.
alex: rollback decision (short): if canary OOMs >=2 in 5m -> set rollout to 0%, pin previous stable (engine:v3.2.0), start incident runbook. else hold and investigate for 2h.
jin: attaching stack traces and `nvidia-smi` snapshots. also packaging log snippet:
```
Packaging: computed sha256=abc123 != expected sha256=def456
ERROR: artifact verification failed
```
nisha: ops will re-run packaging job #4567 now: `./ci/release.sh --artifact v3.2.1-q --rebuild --verify`
sam: quick root-cause hypothesis: quant kernel codegen introduced extra pad to matmul kernel for vector width; increases per-shard memory. we should try backporting the earlier alignment change from v3.2.0 and rebuild.
alex: action plan: (1) deploybot pin for safety, TTL 120m, note; (2) re-run packaging and verify checksum; (3) run perf/regress tests (30m); (4) if hotfix PR ready and tests pass -> push rebuild and resume with 5% canary; (5) if OOMs persist -> rollback to v3.2.0 and open incident.
nisha: executing pin now: `/deploy pin engine:v3.2.1-q --scope=global-canary --ttl=120 --note="size-spike-oom-canary"`
marie: I'll update release notes draft to add: "Hold quantized kernel release due to binary size regression causing canary OOMs. Under investigation."
sam: I'll open hotfix PR with matmul alignment revert/backport. labeling as `hotfix/quant-matmul-size` and request review.
jin: timeline estimate: packaging rebuild in ~15m, perf tests 30m after rebuild, hotfix PR 45-60m. will post updates here.
deploybot: Command acknowledged. engine:v3.2.1-q pinned (scope=global-canary, ttl=120m, note=size-spike-oom-canary). Pin created at 2024-06-xxTxx:xx:xxZ. Use `/deploy unpin engine:v3.2.1-q` to remove early.
alex: thanks — once packaging verifies, run a 5% canary with tight OOM alerts. if stable for 2h we can ramp. :thumbsup:
marie: thanks all. keep notes succinct in the release-notes PR and incident doc. ping here for any blocker updates. :warning:
